description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the distribution of “Task Type” in the referenced study, and it contains three slices. The largest slice is labeled “Article generation (82.9%)” and is shown in a salmon/red color, occupying most of the ring. A second slice is labeled “Article editing (14.6%)” and is colored light blue, taking a noticeably smaller portion on the right side. The remaining slice is a very small yellow segment (approximately 2–3% by visual estimation) whose label appears obscured/blurred in the image. The chart places the title text “Task Type” in the center of the donut, uses percentage labels next to at least two slices, and does not show a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond their size and labeling.
